summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I did (read-only) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/index.ts`/`db/auth.ts`, plus `App.tsx`'s auth gating and `useAuth.tsx`. No files were changed.  ### What the audit actually found Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, I could **not** find an obvious client-side or wiring bug in the primary path: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback and no anonymous state — it only ever talks to `/api/watchlist*`
